data.text:
Dubai’s thriving real estate market continues to offer unmatched opportunities for investors and residents alike, and Hillsedge at Dubai Hills Estate is the latest testament to that promise. Strategically located within Dubai Hills Estate, the upcoming project by the renowned Emaar Properties features elegantly designed apartments. Let’s jump in and explore what makes this project extraordinary!

About Hillsedge

Prime Location

Hillsedge is located along Al Marabea Street (D65) and provides immediate connectivity to Al Khail Road (E44), ensuring excellent access to Dubai’s major destinations. Whether traveling to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, or other key business and leisure hubs, residents will benefit from a smooth and time-efficient commute. Dubai Hills Estate is one of the city’s most prestigious master-planned communities, perfectly balancing nature, lifestyle, and urban convenience.

Exquisite Properties

Hillsedge offers meticulously crafted 1 and 2-bedroom apartments that reflect Emaar’s commitment to exceptional quality and thoughtful design. The residences will feature contemporary architecture with expansive layouts, large windows that bring in abundant natural light, and stunning views of the surrounding green spaces. Designed for modern living, these apartments ensure a luxurious experience while accommodating diverse lifestyle needs.

The properties are competitively priced, starting at just AED 1.84M, making them a sought-after opportunity for discerning investors and homeowners.

World-Class Amenities

Residents at Hillsedge at Dubai Hills Estate will have access to an array of premium amenities designed to enhance everyday living:

  • Fully Equipped Gym – Modern fitness facilities tailored for residents who prioritize health and wellness.
  • Swimming Pool – A refreshing pool ideal for relaxation and recreation.
  • Vibrant Kids’ Play Area – Safe and engaging spaces for children to play and enjoy.
  • Skate Bowl & Mini-Golf – Unique outdoor features offering exciting recreational activities for all ages.
  • Dry Fountains & Art Elements – Aesthetic spaces that combine creativity and leisure.
  • Outdoor Cinema & Amphitheatre – Perfect for entertainment and community gatherings under the stars.
  • Community and Park Spaces – Beautifully landscaped areas perfect for leisure, socializing, and outdoor activities.
  • Retail and Dining Options Nearby – Convenient access to shopping and gourmet dining experiences.

These Hillsedge by Emaar amenities perfectly complement the upscale lifestyle expected in Dubai Hills Estate, making it a standout option for residents seeking comfort, convenience, and leisure in one place.

Why Invest in Hillsedge by Emaar Properties?

Investing in Hillsedge at Dubai Hills Estate by Emaar presents numerous advantages for both first-time buyers and seasoned investors. Below are the key reasons that make this development a top investment choice:

  1. Developed by a Renowned Developer
    Hillsedge is brought to you by Emaar Properties, one of the most trusted and globally recognized real estate developers. With a proven track record of delivering iconic projects such as Burj Khalifa and Dubai Marina, Emaar ensures unparalleled quality and reliability.
  2. Prime Location in a Sought-After Community
    Dubai Hills Estate is one of the most desirable master communities in Dubai, offering residents a blend of luxury and nature with parks, golf courses, and premium infrastructure.
  3. Excellent Connectivity
    Located along Al Marabea Street and near Al Khail Road, Emaar Hillsedge Residences offers seamless connectivity to all major highways, ensuring residents are minutes away from Dubai’s central business districts, malls, and airports.
  4. High Rental Demand and Yield Potential
    Due to its prime location, modern amenities, and upscale lifestyle, Hillsedge at Dubai Hills Estate is expected to attract strong rental demand. This translates to excellent rental yields and a lucrative long-term investment.
  5. Attractive Payment Plan and Competitive Pricing
    With an 80/20 payment plan, investors can easily secure premium residences. Starting prices of AED 1.84M offer incredible value for properties in such a prestigious development, ensuring affordability without compromising luxury.

Hillsedge at Dubai Hills Estate is not just another real estate opportunity—it is a well-planned investment that offers luxury, strategic location, and long-term value. Expected to be completed by January 2029, Hillsedge stands out as a premier choice in Dubai’s thriving real estate market. To learn more about this exceptional project or gain access to Hillsedge properties, connect with our experts at Provident Estate today.

About Emaar Properties

Emaar Properties is one of the world’s leading real estate developers, renowned for shaping Dubai’s iconic skyline. Established in 1997, Emaar has delivered world-class residential, commercial, and hospitality projects, including global landmarks like the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Dubai Marina. With a commitment to quality, innovation, and excellence, Emaar Properties continues redefining urban lifestyles and setting new real estate standards.

faqs.question: What is the starting price for Hillsedge by Emaar Properties for sale?

data.answer: The starting price for apartments at Hillsedge at Dubai Hills Estate is AED 1.84 million.

faqs.question: What is Hillsedge by Emaar's payment plan?

data.answer: Hillsedge offers an 80/20 payment plan, where 80% is paid during construction, and the remaining 20% is paid upon handover.

faqs.question: When will Emaar Hillsedge Residences Dubai Hills Estate be completed?

data.answer: The handover for Emaar Hillsedge Residences is expected in January 2029.
Hillsedge is located in Dubai Hills Estate, along Al Marabea Street (D65), with easy access to Al Khail Road (E44).

faqs.question: What amenities are offered at Hillsedge at Dubai Hills Estate?

data.answer: Hillsedge provides premium amenities, including swimming pools, fitness facilities, landscaped parks, walking and cycling tracks, and proximity to Dubai Hills Mall.
